summary_en: Up to 2,000,000 shares (1.0% S/O ex-treasury) | ¥3,500M budget ceiling | open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange | Aug 3 to Sep 30, 2026 | stated reason: capital-efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns per medium-term plan 2030
title_en: Notice of Decision Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Pursuant to Bylaws Based on Provisions of Article 165, Paragraph 2 of Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, Shikoku Electric Power Company's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 2,000,000 treasury shares (1.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) within a ¥3,500 million budget ceiling. The shares will be purchased via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from 3 August to 30 September 2026. The acquisition is undertaken to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns as part of the company's medium-term business plan 2030. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 1,891,437 treasury shares (excluding 196,000 shares held in a stock grant trust account), with 205,636,765 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
